ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (dark) to 30% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) pigmentation localized at the distal tips. Extensive high-contrast mottling and white circular rings distributed across the central and medial zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 40-45 degrees relative to the fluke axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency serrations and several distinct, deeper indentations (low-frequency notches) on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a sigmoid curve, exhibiting concavity near the median notch and transitioning to slight convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (scars) are visible across both lobes, with a dense grouping on the right lobe near the lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear streaks (rake marks) are visible, particularly on the pigmented dark sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle colonization and multiple linear rake marks distributed across the ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense constellation of circular rosette scars on the right medial fluke region.
